name: Tomorrowind
tagline: A House Hlaalu colony builder for OpenMW
description: Found and run a House Hlaalu colony anywhere in Morrowind: settlers, jobs, trade and buildings you place wherever you like. A free mod for OpenMW 0.52 and later.

studio.name: Studio Roor
studio.description: Studio Roor is Drikus Roor's evening studio: new websites for small businesses, and new life for a game from 2002.

support.label: Buy me a coffee
support.text: Tomorrowind is free and stays free. If you enjoy your colony, a coffee keeps the evenings going.

footerNote: Tomorrowind is a fan-made mod. It needs your own copy of The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Bethesda Softworks. The code is licensed under GPL v3.
